result.summary: I've escalated this to a person at high priority. It's an emergency: no heating or hot water in January for a household with a 3-month-old baby who now has a cough. The landlord's 'go ahead' only covers up to £300 and says to use Brightwell Gas. That clashes with Ashgrove Heating's £480 quote, and Ashgrove can't come until Thursday. I sent the tenant safety advice and told them nobody is booked yet. I emailed the landlord to confirm we have her conditions, and the team now needs to phone the tenant, Brightwell Gas and the landlord. Nothing is booked and no money has been committed.
result.situation: The ticket is at the 'scheduling' stage but nobody is booked. Ashgrove Heating quoted £480 inc VAT and can't attend until Thursday 15th; the quote attachment never arrived and the 08:06 SMS to the contractor failed. Landlord Priya replied: "Go ahead but don't spend more than £300 without calling me first. Use Brightwell Gas". The tenant asked for a phone call because the baby has a cough and they can't heat bottles properly.
